synopsis: I don’t know how it happened, but somehow I’ve died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn’t weird enough, I’m now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I’m determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy’s entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of avoiding my disastrous end. But I seriously underestimated just how powerful Weiss truly is, and I wind up stunning everyone at the exams! Have I somehow become more powerful than the hero? A fantasy series about changing the villain’s fate with hard work and amazing powers! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: NINE PEAKS
synopsis: Gaku Mashio was a first-year high school student who lived with his father. He lost his father in a sudden accident, just as he got suspended from school after getting into a fight. On the night of his father's wake, Gaku went fishing on the shore in memory of his father, but he fell into the sea and was returned 22 years into the past. Gaku's father, Harumi, who was the same age as Gaku at that time, saved him from the water. Harumi's parents (Gaku's grandparents) took a liking to Gaku, and accepted him into their family under the name Gaku Miyagi. His grandparents even encouraged him to go to Seiha High School, same as his father. Twenty-two years ago, the town of Kurei was full of delinquents. Now Gaku and his father will fight their way to the top of the town! (Source: Shonen Champion, translated)

title: Tetsu Sabi to 1000 Carat
synopsis: This is a world where "Jewel-sama" are born with jewels in their eyes and special abilities. They live in a vast mansion called the "Jewel Box," and their duty is to grant people's wishes. The new arrival at the Jewel Box is Yuni, a girl with iron ore in her eyes, who is far from a beautiful jewel. Although she started her life as a "Master Jewel," she was not able to help people as much as she would like. Then she meets Alecrea, a master jeweler who is rumored to be a "Jewel Killer." He seems to be pursuing the unknown dark side of the jewelry box. In order to get closer to the truth, Yuni helps Alecrea and meets various other jewelry masters. Little does she know that she herself will eventually become the one to change the world. Follow your wishes and uncover the truth of the beautiful jewel box world. The unpredictable buddy and love fantasy between a girl with black iron and a rebellious young man begins! (Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)

title: Chie Aru Koibito
synopsis: The protagonists of "Chie Aru Koibito," Ushidome-kun and Shirakaba-san, are both intelligent class representatives who judge things rationally. Even though their classmates extol the two as a perfect match, Shirakaba-san declares that she "doesn't have even a second to lose herself in love." Ushidome-kun is honestly shocked by this, but he also appeals that he is "not in a state to fall in love," which upsets Shirakaba-san. They are both too conscious of each other, and the rationality of the two explosive people is on the verge of collapse. This is the love story of a male and female honor student who cannot be honest with each other and are tormented by their own worldly desires. (Source: Natalie, translated)
